effect.u_message: Mikhail, if you reach the camp first: we moved the wounded into the southwestern tent. The alarm is outside it, beside the broken ties. During the test, the thing by the specimen left the northern tent and followed the noise. It turned on Pavel only when he stepped into the open. The crank runs slowly. There was time to get behind the canvas; he stayed beside the crank. — Lena

The last prayer has been crossed out. Beneath it: We barred the front doors to keep the strangers away. Now the footsteps are inside. Irina took the remaining blankets through the sacristy; I could not persuade her to come back for the stone. The western wall is broken. If anyone still hears the bell, let them follow the living, not its voice.

The letters were written on a strip torn from a sleeve: The eastern way is wide enough to carry him, but the scratches there are fresh. I left the iron bar where the prop broke. We came back around the stone chime and reached the brace from below. The peg can be pulled from that side. If he wakes, we will try the ladder before we try the red face again.

The wrapping carries the same two-knotted cord as the ward farther up the path. Only one set of bones remains here. A shallow groove in the soil leads toward the abandoned camp, then disappears beneath new roots.
